programs.title: Art Fundamentals
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Write a visual analysis/critique of their own and other's art on both form and content, and its relation to a historical and global context.

Produce artworks reflecting an understanding of basic components of design and composition such as line, shape, value, texture, space, color, scale, proportion, balance, mood, movement, mass and emphasis.

programs.title: Computer Project Management
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Manage activities with defined beginning and end in time, defined scope and resources accomplish a singular goal.
Coordinate a project team to deliver the on-time, on-budget results.
Prioritize activities and communicate results, milestones, and deadlines.

programs.title: Dietary Manager
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Synthesize the knowledge and skills to pass the national Certified Dietary Manager (CDM) exam.
Communicate with staff and clients in a professional and culturally sensitive manner.
Display effective dietary manager skills.
Provide and maintain the highest level of personal ethical behavior.

programs.title: Fluorescence Bioscience Microscopy
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Acquire digital images on a variety of research-level digital optical microscopes, including motorized widefield fluorescence systems, a spectral imaging confocal and a spinning disk confocal.
Master diverse microscopy software programs for all four main brands of research optical microscopes.

programs.title: Municipal Gardener, Level 1
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Demonstrate the following basic horticultural practices: proper planting, pruning and routine maintenance for landscape plants.

programs.title: Municipal Gardener, Level 2
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Demonstrate the following horticultural practices: Identify basic irrigation components and installation of drip irrigation systems; proper planting, pruning and routine maintenance for landscape plants.

programs.title: Nursery Management
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
outcomes: Perform state-of-the-art sustainable operations of a professional nursery person in both wholesale and retail nursery op

programs.title: Nursing
outcomes: Apply professional and theoretical concepts of nursing theories related to evidenced-based nursing practice when working with the healthcare team in caring for patients, families, and communities.
Develop and implement safe and skillful nursing care for patients, families, and communities.
Participate effectively as a member of a health care team by applying their knowledge of the nursing process.
Develop an awareness of him/herself as a person and as a practitioner with respect to his/her abilities, needs, motives culture, values and attitudes.

programs.title: Optical Microscopy
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Confidently acquire digital images on a variety of research-level optical microscopes, including phase, DIC, and widefield epifluorescence.
Operate diverse microscopy software programs.
Prepare brightfield specimens for optical microscopy.
Execute basic cell and molecular biology lab techniques, including aseptic technique, following good lab practices.

programs.title: Paramedic
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
outcomes: Complete the National Registry written and skills exams
Perform the requisite skills in assessing and treating the patient at the paramedic level
Demonstrate professional behavior consistent for employment as a licensed paramedic
